To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Bright Score improves the accuracy of job matching, that it does so by incorporating social media profile data into the matching process, and that the Bright Score is a novel and effective method for incorporating social media profile information into the matching process.
The addition of external data and social media profile data improves the classification of candidates by 30-40% over the classification accuracy obtained using only traditional resume information."

(1) The addition of social media data improves classification accuracy, (2) the addition of external data improves classification accuracy even further, (3) the addition of both external and social media data results in a significant improvement in accuracy over the addition of social data alone, (4) the addition of social and external data results in a classification accuracy comparable to the human performance in the controlled study.

the problem of matching job candidates to job descriptions.
the development of a new approach for resume matching that is more accurate than traditional methods.
the problem of matching candidates to jobs using social data.
